turnout.notes: Rhode Island turnout rows remain EAC 2024 V2 city/town jurisdiction fallback rows. The official SOS Data Hub 2024-11-01 city/town-and-precinct registration lead retains Active, Inactive, and Pending status rows separately and is 794 all-status registrations above EAC; it has no compatible ballots-cast or voter-participation field, so it does not replace EAC turnout.

historicalBaselines.warning: Rhode Island historical baseline rows are contextual official BOE county-aggregated rows for 2012, 2016, and 2020, plus non-geographic Federal Precincts rows left unforced for county FIPS joins. Each archive is read from an explicit finalized root member and validated against its official statewide JSON totals. The read-only production-versus-staging reconciliation accepts the intentional 2012/2016 municipal-to-county display-grain replacement: all five county aggregates plus Federal Precincts reconcile with zero vote delta in every year. This acceptance does not itself authorize production promotion.
